description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Creates a DRAFT content item. Nothing is posted. Give `text` plus optional media (`videoUrl` / `imageUrl`, or `videoStorageId` / `imageStorageId` from upload_media), target `platforms`, `brandId` (from list_brands; omitted → the brand last active in the dashboard), per-platform captions (`platformText`), creator `credits`, `labels` and YouTube options. Returns the new `id` — pass it as `contentId` to publish or add_queue_items.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/content.)

copyFromContentId.description: COPY TO BRAND (staff and the Agency plan): the id of an existing item (GET /api/v2/content) to copy into `brandId` as a new draft. Images, video, slides, documents and thumbnails are copied into new storage objects, so deleting the source never breaks the copy. Combine only with `brandId` (required, a brand id — not "personal") and optionally `text` (replaces the caption; omitted = the source caption). Labels, mentions, campaign/experiment links and post history are not copied. Needs an account-wide key. Errors: 403 below the Agency plan or with a brand-bound key; 404 unknown item or brand; 409 the item changed mid-copy; 413 the brand's storage is full; 422 the item is already in that brand or its media is missing.

credits.description: Creator credits for work this post uses. Added to the published caption above the flayr footer, one line each: model → "Print your own: <url> (model by <author>)"; other kinds → "Credit: <title> by <author> <url>". Never added twice (a URL already in the caption is skipped); on X a shorter line (or no URL) is used, or the credits are left out, before the caption text is ever cut. YouTube: description only, never the title.

site.description: Detected from the URL when omitted (e.g. MakerWorld, Printables, Thingiverse).

url.description: Absolute http(s) link to the credited work.

labels.description: Normalized "key:value" labels (keys and values are lower-cased, spaces become "-"). Linked keys: campaign:<media campaign id>, experiment:<experiment id> (+ variant:<name> or the experiment's compareKey), type:<post type> (short, long-form, carousel, image, text, reel, story, poem, timelapse…). Free keys work too: cut:opus, lane:tech, parent:pantheon-part-1, ab:<pair id> (an A/B pair). Labels are copied onto every post made from the draft, and compared in GET /api/v2/analytics/experiments.

platformText.description: Per-platform captions: platform id → the caption that platform gets instead of `text`, e.g. { "twitter": "short version" }. Each must fit its platform: X 280 (a link counts 23, an emoji 2), Bluesky 300, Threads 500, Instagram 2200, LinkedIn 3000. Platforms without one get `text` when it fits, else an automatic short version: the first line, the credits in short form, as many hashtags as fit and the short flayr link (hashtags go first, then the credit link becomes "Model by <author>"; words are never cut). PATCH merges: a null (or "") value clears that platform, platformText: null clears all. At publish every platform is validated on its own caption: one failing platform no longer fails the others — the post publishes to the rest and reports the failures in platformErrors.

referralFooter.description: Caption watermark: appends "Posted with flayr.social — try it: flayr.social/r/<code>/<ch>" to each platform's text (<code> is your referral code — your custom one if you claimed it; <ch> names the platform: yt, x, li, ig, tt, fb, th, bs). (YouTube: description only, never the title; X: the shorter "via flayr.social/r/<code>/x" or nothing when it would not fit — your text is never cut). On by default. false removes it only on plans that can remove the Flayr watermark (Pro and up); omitted follows your watermark setting.

youtube.description: Stored on the draft and used when it is published (POST /api/v2/publish with contentId). YouTube upload options, applied to YouTube targets only. madeForKids is always sent to YouTube (default false). A missing title is derived from the first sentence of the caption, cut to 100 characters at a word boundary. SCHEDULED UPLOADS: the video is uploaded ahead of scheduledAt. "public" is uploaded as private and released by YouTube at the scheduled time; "unlisted" is watchable by anyone with the link from upload time; "private" stays private.

categoryId.description: YouTube category id, e.g. "28" (Science & Technology). YouTube default: 22.

firstComment.description: For scheduled videos, posted at the scheduled time.

playlistId.description: From GET /api/v2/youtube/playlists for the same brand.
